title: Pizza Dragon Fantasy
description: A giant bright green cartoon dragon with a bow on its ear sits on sandy terrain, happily eating a large slice of pizza with cheese dripping. A woman with short dark hair in a green top and denim shorts stands beside it holding another pizza slice, set against a surreal landscape with a striped cathedral, bizarre black and white patterned structures, floating rings, and a winding path.
